request: Preserve H1A v1 request and authentication semantics: HTTP Basic; only grant_type=client_credentials in body. No caller/audience/scope selector; the server binds one audience to the authenticated client_id.
credentials: Separate CSPRNG secrets per profile and rotation slot; reject reuse across profiles. Profile IDs authenticate clients; caller and audience are fixed by server policy.
isolation: Every token has one exact audience and canonical caller. The new history-recovery profile is separate from catalog-pricing.catalog-recovery, whose audience remains identity-tenancy.catalog-recovery.
activation: Candidate policy only. Existing v1 bytes and admissions remain unchanged. No consumer lock, admission, publication, or production enablement is implied.
privacy: Never version real secrets, tokens or authentication payloads. Logs contain no credential values.
